textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900

The TQ module TQMxE39C1 is an advanced computing solution based on the latest generation of Intel Atom processors, specifically the Intel Atom x5/x7 E3900 series, also known as "Apollo Lake-I." This compact COM Express Type 6 module offers exceptional compute performance, robust security features, and impressive media processing capabilities. Its compact form factor makes it suitable for a wide range of applications, from real-time computing and industrial automation to digital surveillance, aviation, medical devices, and retail systems.

Key features of the TQMxE39C1 include support for triple displays with resolutions up to 4K UHD through interfaces like DP, HDMI, eDP, and LVDS. It also boasts dual/quad-core processors with clock speeds of up to 2.5 GHz, ensuring high-performance computing. With Gigabit Ethernet for high-speed connectivity, this module can handle data-intensive tasks efficiently.

The module's design prioritizes robustness, and it can even be equipped with protective coatings for added durability. It aligns with the industry-standard PICMG COM Express Compact (COM.0 R2.1) with a Type 6 pinout. The integrated Intel graphics processor delivers stunning 4K graphics output, supports 3D processing, and enhances video encode and playback performance significantly.

Furthermore, time-coordinated computing capabilities enable synchronized processes within IoT networks and industrial control applications. The onboard eMMC storage, available in capacities up to 64 GB, provides flexibility while reducing overall BOM costs. Options such as conformal coating and optimized cooling solutions make the TQMxE39C1 suitable for ruggedized applications.

In summary, the TQ module TQMxE39C1 combines Intel's Atom processors, exceptional graphics capabilities, robust design, and versatile connectivity to meet the demands of various high-performance embedded computing applications.

text.text:
Features

  • Triple Display Support: Enables connections to up to three displays with DP, HDMI, eDP, and LVDS interfaces, supporting resolutions up to 4K UHD.
  • High-Speed Gigabit Ethernet: Provides fast and reliable network connectivity for data-intensive tasks and industrial applications.
  • Robust Design: Designed to withstand challenging environments, ensuring long-term reliability and durability.
  • Flexible Storage Options: Offers up to 64 GB of soldered eMMC storage and supports LVDS or native eDP, allowing for adaptable storage configurations.
  • Comprehensive I/O Interfaces: Includes USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 ports, serial ports, SATA, PCIe, GPIO, and more for versatile peripheral connections.
